title: Really Cooking
description: Cooking in Minecraft has always been simple, but not anymore!
body:
Cooking in Minecraft has always been simple, but not anymore!

Now, not only can you make over 150 unique dishes, but you'll also learn how to make them IN REAL LIFE!

The goal of the mod is to bring gastronomy to Minecraft in a new and fun way, teaching players how to make these same recipes in real life.

So what are you waiting for? Let's cook!
